name: kangxi-exe
description: KangXi.exe — Imperial & Modern multi-device Agent workbench with Local-First auto-import, universal self-hosted Node/Docker + Cloudflare backend, and MCP memorials

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @kangxi/protocol build && pnpm --filter @kangxi/app-core build && pnpm --filter @kangxi/server-core build && pnpm --filter @kangxi/server build && pnpm --filter @kangxi/client build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @kangxi/protocol test && pnpm --filter @kangxi/app-core test && pnpm --filter @kangxi/cloudflare test && pnpm --filter @kangxi/server test
